sentences.chapter: The Queen of the Field Mice

sentences.en: The Guardian took them to a green palace.

sentences.en: "The Great Oz will see you soon."

sentences.en: Dorothy and her friends waited in the palace for the Great Oz.

sentences.en: Dorothy was called to see the Great Oz.

sentences.en: The head could talk, but it had no arms and no legs.

sentences.en: "I am Oz, the Great and Terrible," the head said loudly.

sentences.en: "Why have you come to see me?"

sentences.en: "I want to go home to Kansas," said Dorothy.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o veux:v rentrer:v chez:o moi:o au:o Kansas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Dorothy:o .:o

sentences.en: "My friends want brains, a heart, and courage."

sentences.en: "I will help you, but first you must help me," said the head.

sentences.en: But now, Oz was not a head.

sentences.tgt: Elle:o dit:v la:o même:a règle:n à:o l':o Épouvantail:o aussi:a ::o tue:v la:o sorcière:n d':o abord:a .:o

sentences.en: Oz called the Tin Woodman and the Lion in next, one at a time.

sentences.en: To the Lion, Oz was fire.

sentences.en: The four friends went west to find the Wicked Witch.

sentences.en: Not one wolf got away.

sentences.en: The crows flew at the four friends.

sentences.en: Not one crow got away.
sentences.tgt: Pas:o un:o corbeau:n ne:o s':o échappa:v .:o

sentences.en: The witch called many black bees.

sentences.en: The Scarecrow pulled out his straw and put it on Dorothy, Toto, and the Lion.

sentences.en: The bees flew at the Tin Woodman, but their stings broke on his tin body.

sentences.en: The monkeys took Dorothy and Toto.

sentences.en: She put a bar on the kitchen floor, but Dorothy could not see it.

sentences.en: A bucket of water was in the kitchen.

sentences.en: The witch gave a great cry.

sentences.en: The Lion thanked Dorothy for her help.

sentences.en: The Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman thanked the people of the castle.

sentences.en: "Stay and rule us," the people said to the Tin Woodman.
